## Style B ⋯ › Rename: Style B2
  1  GET /api/core-nodes
  2  PUT /api/styles/2
       {
         "name": "Style B2",
         "description": "",
         "process_id": 1,
         "expected_catid": ""
       }
  3  GET /api/processes
  4  GET /api/processes/1/composer
  5  GET /api/processes/1/styles
  6  POST /api/processes/1/flow/preview
       (the boot preview's body, as requests-open-process.txt pins it)
-- sheet closed
